mode: Built-in image_gen; model selector not exposed
scope: Six About/Why AMAFH feature-card photographs; matching EN/AR share assets

assets.subject: meeting
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original AMAFH website feature-card photograph, about, slot 1.
Primary request: Generate one brand-new panoramic LANDSCAPE photograph in a 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 pixels wide by 1024 pixels tall. This is a wide horizontal website card, not a portrait, square image, collage or screenshot.
Scene: Two adults, a male financial adviser in charcoal business casual and a mature woman in dusty mauve, seated opposite each other at an oak table discussing a plain unmarked folder. Bright modern Dubai-inspired lounge. Eye-level camera showing the complete upper bodies, both heads and hands, plus enough room around the table.
Composition: The whole canvas is the photograph. Pull the camera back to show the full scene horizontally. Important people and objects belong inside the central 70% of the canvas, leaving at least 15% safe space above every head and 10% at both sides. No cropped heads, chins, hands or main objects. Never fill the frame with an oversized face. No artificial blurred padding or stretched background. Design the scene natively for the full 2:1 canvas so it does not require a portrait-to-landscape crop.
Style: premium, realistic editorial corporate financial-services photography; natural daylight, real-looking skin and textiles, cream and charcoal with restrained dusty mauve and pink/purple accents. All people, properties and financial products are illustrative, not real AMAFH employees or clients.
Avoid: any lettering, numbers, bank branding, logos, watermarks, readable documents/screens, harsh HDR, duplicate composition from another image.
